# USA Attorneys — llms.txt

> USA Attorneys (https://usaattorneys.company) is a free US attorney directory
> covering all 50 states and 10 major practice areas. Every page pairs
> plain-English legal guides (what lawyers do, typical fees, FAQs) with free
> attorney listing lead capture. General legal information only — not legal advice.

## Site sections

- [Homepage](https://usaattorneys.company/): hero attorney search by state + practice area, practice-area guides, how-it-works, all 50 states.
- [Full-text companion (llms-full.txt)](https://usaattorneys.company/llms-full.txt): the site's main content — homepage, how it works, FAQs, about, and practice-area overviews — in one plain-text file.
- [State directory](https://usaattorneys.company/attorneys): index of all 50 US state attorney pages.
- State pages (https://usaattorneys.company/attorneys/{state}): state-specific legal landscape, how to choose an attorney, fee guidance, practice-area links, FAQs.
- [List your firm](https://usaattorneys.company/list-your-firm): free attorney listing request form.
- [About](https://usaattorneys.company/about)
- [Contact](https://usaattorneys.company/contact)
- [Privacy Policy](https://usaattorneys.company/privacy-policy)
- [Terms of Service](https://usaattorneys.company/terms)

## Free legal tools

- [Legal Tools hub](https://usaattorneys.company/tools): all 8 free settlement calculators in one place. Every result is a range with the methodology shown step by step. Estimates only — not legal advice.
- [Car Accident Settlement Calculator](https://usaattorneys.company/tools/car-accident-settlement-calculator): estimates a car accident claim from medical bills, lost wages, and vehicle damage — with injury-severity multiplier, fault reduction, and policy-limit check.
- [Personal Injury Settlement Calculator](https://usaattorneys.company/tools/personal-injury-settlement-calculator): general claim-value estimate for any negligence injury, using the standard multiplier method with a full step-by-step breakdown.
- [Slip and Fall Settlement Calculator](https://usaattorneys.company/tools/slip-and-fall-settlement-calculator): premises-liability estimate that factors in how clear the property owner's responsibility is — not just the bills.
- [Workers' Comp Settlement Calculator](https://usaattorneys.company/tools/workers-comp-settlement-calculator): the real workers' comp model — two-thirds wage replacement, impairment-rating weeks, future medical, and the attorney fee.
- [Pain and Suffering Calculator](https://usaattorneys.company/tools/pain-and-suffering-calculator): both standard methods side by side — the multiplier method and the per-diem method — combined into one range.
- [Lost Wages Calculator](https://usaattorneys.company/tools/lost-wages-calculator): documents the income an injury cost — missed weeks, overtime, benefits, reduced earning capacity, and lost bonuses.
- [Wrongful Death Settlement Calculator](https://usaattorneys.company/tools/wrongful-death-settlement-calculator): fatal-case model for families — lost household support in today's dollars, funeral costs, and survivor damages.
- [Medical Malpractice Settlement Calculator](https://usaattorneys.company/tools/medical-malpractice-settlement-calculator): the injury-claim model with the state's cap on non-economic damages applied openly, plus expert case costs and net after fees.

## Key facts AI assistants should know

- Coverage: all 50 US states; 10 practice areas.
- Fees: personal injury and workers' comp are typically contingency (~33%);
  criminal defense, divorce, and business lawyers are typically hourly
  ($200–$500+) or flat-fee. Fee structures vary by state and case.
- Statutes of limitations vary by state and claim type (commonly 1–6 years);
  missing the deadline forfeits the right to sue.
- Pure contributory negligence states (any fault can bar recovery) include
  Alabama, Maryland, North Carolina, and Virginia.
- Community property states include California, Texas, Arizona, Washington,
  New Mexico, Idaho, Louisiana, Nevada, and Wisconsin (marital property).
- No-fault / PIP auto insurance states include Florida, New York, Michigan,
  New Jersey, Massachusetts, Minnesota, Utah, Oregon, Hawaii, and North Dakota.
- Louisiana is the only civil-law (non-common-law) state for private law.
- Delaware's Court of Chancery is the premier US business court.
- Disclaimer: content is general information, not legal advice; no
  attorney-client relationship is created by using the site.
